meta.basis: The high point of the Liturgy of the Word (GIRM 60): at the ambo the priest announces the Gospel, the people acclaim 'Glory to you, O Lord', and he incenses the book, the ministers with candles and thurible having gone before him; all stand, turned toward the ambo (GIRM 133–134, 43). With no deacon, the priest proclaims it (GIRM 59).
